description: Replace the scalar recursive batch-160 n=128 kernel with a blocked tensor-core decomposition: factor FP32 diagonal micro-panels, solve register/shared panels, and issue WGMMA or WMMA lower rank-k updates within a persistent caller-stream CTA. Group matrices only where resource occupancy permits, retain exact output caching and all other shape dispatch, and explore 16/32-wide tiles.

Replace the recursive n128 factor with one persistent 512-thread CTA using FP32 32-wide diagonal panels and warp triangular solves, then compensated high/low TF32 WMMA lower rank-k updates. Caller-current launch, banned-text scan, kernelguard, all 17 official tests, and fresh-seed guard passed. n128 measured 170.152 us versus about 57 us for the parent; full geomean was 1070.765 us.

Replace warp-per-row n128 panel solves with 128 independent four-thread register row teams, retaining the 32-wide FP32 panel and compensated TF32 WMMA rank-k schedule. All mandatory static gates, official tests, and fresh guards passed. n128 improved from 170.152 to 65.501 us; the full metric improved from 1070.765 to 1008.151 us, remaining above the 998.975 parent.

Narrow the persistent n128 blocked factor from 32-wide to 16-wide FP32 panels and four-thread register solves, with compensated TF32 WMMA rank-k updates after each panel. Caller-current launch and every static/official/fresh correctness gate passed. n128 improved from 65.501 to 62.900 us; unchanged-shape noise left full geomean 1008.340 us versus 1008.151 for width 32 and 998.975 parent.

Reduce each 16-wide n128 rank-k update from three compensated TF32 products to one TF32 product. Build, banned-text, and kernelguard passed; dense n128 passed at scaled residual 11.7, but the official condition-5 spectrum case produced NaN/Inf, so validation failed before benchmarking.

Retain three compensated TF32 products only on diagonal trailing tiles and use one product off diagonal. Build and static gates passed; dense n128 passed with scaled residual 9.35, but off-diagonal error still propagated into the official condition-5 spectrum factor and produced NaN/Inf, so validation failed before benchmark.

Replace the three-product high/low TF32 expansion with two products H*H^T and (H+32R)*(H+32R)^T, reconstructing the cross correction in FP32 accumulator registers. All mandatory gates passed; condition-5 spectrum residual was 0.437 versus NaN for one-product TF32. n128 improved from 62.900 to 61.486 us and full geomean to 1002.207 us.

Narrow each 16-column FP32 panel-solve row team from four threads to two, halving subgroup shuffles while doubling per-lane register dot work. All gates passed, but n128 regressed from 61.486 to 68.462 us; full geomean was 1007.487 us amid faster unrelated n512 sampling.

Restore four-thread register row solves and cache one FP32 reciprocal per 16-wide diagonal panel pivot in a shared side array, replacing every trailing-row division with multiplication. All gates passed; n128 measured 62.522 us versus 61.486 us without explicit reciprocal storage, and full geomean was 1005.094 us.

Move the persistent n128 blocked matrix from 64 KiB shared memory into its cached global output buffer, retaining only 128 pivot reciprocals in shared memory and issuing aligned WMMA directly through L2/global state. Correctness passed, but n128 regressed from 61.486-62.522 to 99.423 us; full geomean was 1035.583 us.

Return blocked state to shared memory and widen the valid two-product scaled-residual schedule from 16 to 32 columns, retaining four-thread register solves and shared pivot reciprocals. All gates passed, but n128 regressed to 90.073 us versus 61.486 us at width 16, consistent with wider solve/register pressure; full geomean was 1022.902 us.

Restore the selected shared-memory 16-wide two-product schedule and vectorize lower-triangle input staging plus output writeback with aligned float4 transactions and lane masks. Every correctness gate passed. n128 improved from 61.486 to 58.924 us; unrelated shape variance left full geomean at 1007.020 us.

Eliminate two temporary WMMA accumulators by weighting H and H+32R operands as -31/32 and -1/32, accumulating both products directly into the trailing FP32 tile. All gates passed, but spectrum residual rose from 0.437 to 10.1 and n128 measured 59.865 versus 58.924 for explicit FP32 correction. Full geomean was 998.523 us due unrelated favorable sampling.

Restore the explicit-FP32 two-product correction byte-for-byte from c15a82a while retaining float4 staging, then run final certification. Banned-text, kernelguard, all 17 official tests, fresh-seed guard, and all 15 benchmark cells passed. n128 confirmed at 58.464 us after 58.924 us initially; full geomean measured 996.999 us versus the 998.975 parent.

Completed 13 logged trials over the blocked n128 tensor-core objective. Final selected commit is byte-identical to c15a82a: persistent caller-current 512-thread CTA, shared 128x128 state, FP32 16-wide register panels/solves, float4 triangular staging, and a two-WMMA scaled-residual identity with explicit FP32 correction. It passed banned-text, kernelguard, 17/17 official tests, the fresh-seed guard, and 15/15 benchmark cells; profiling remained waived. n128 progressed 170.152 (width32 warp solve) -> 65.501 (four-thread register solve) -> 62.900 (width16) -> 61.486 (two-product correction) -> 58.924, confirmed 58.464 us with float4 staging. Full confirmation was 996.999 us versus 998.975 parent. One-product TF32 and diagonal-only compensation both produced NaN/Inf on condition-5 spectrum; direct weighted accumulation passed but raised spectrum residual from 0.437 to 10.1 and measured 59.865 us. Width32 two-product measured 90.073, two-thread solve 68.462, explicit reciprocal cache 62.522, and global/L2 state 99.423 us. Keep this line moving with native SM100 tcgen05/WGMMA fragments, a fused factor/solve pipeline, or complementary-triangle multi-matrix shared packing; these remain concrete structural variants beyond the measured WMMA schedules.

Replace the scalar recursive batch-160 n=128 kernel with a blocked tensor-core decomposition: factor FP32 diagonal micro-panels, solve register/shared panels, and issue WGMMA or WMMA lower rank-k updates within a persistent caller-stream CTA. Group matrices only where resource occupancy permits, retain exact output caching and all other shape dispatch, and explore 16/32-wide tiles.

Fused each next 16x16 panel factorization into warp 0 immediately after its diagonal two-product WMMA rank-k tile, overlapping it with other warps' independent trailing tiles; full validation passed; n=128 was 60.489 us.

Moved fused next-panel factorization after warp 0's final assigned WMMA tile, keeping factor live ranges outside the rank-k loop and avoiding delay of warp 0's second tile; full validation passed; n=128 58.811 us, full geomean 995.218 us.

Replaced the 16x16 WMMA tile swarm with a native SM100 tcgen05 M128xN128 TF32 rank-k prototype using compact K-major packed shared operands and two compensated tensor-memory accumulators; build and execution succeeded, but dense and spectrum n=128 validation produced NaN/Inf.

Rebuilt the native tcgen05 path from the last valid parent with a one-point accumulator diagnostic. At logical diagonal (16,16), tcgen05 loads reported 0.068147 versus scalar expected 0.133125 for dense and -0.058309 versus expected 0.143986 for spectrum, proving the failure lies in operand/output mapping rather than panel factor arithmetic.

Rebuilt native tcgen05 from the valid parent and moved tcgen05.wait::ld immediately after each paired tensor-memory load, matching CUTLASS epilogue ordering before accumulator consumption. Dense and spectrum n=128 still produced NaN/Inf, so load-fence placement did not repair the mapping error.

Corrected native tcgen05 tensor-memory loads by mapping warp rank within each warpgroup to the legal 32-DP subpartition, partitioning warpgroups over N, and adding the canonical post-mbarrier fence. All validation and fresh guards passed; n=128 125.288 us, full geomean 1052.877 us.
Trim tcgen05 packing and TMEM loads to each panel trailing width; validation and guards pass; n128 113.559 us, full metric 1038.574809
Factor each next 16x16 panel in its owning epilogue warp and overlap with remaining TMEM loads; validation and guards pass; n128 111.662 us, full metric 1037.183702

Reuse one 8 KiB packing buffer by completing high product before overwriting with scaled values; validation and guards pass; n128 116.201 us, full metric 1046.095668 (regression from added synchronization)

Pack simultaneous high/scaled tcgen05 operands into disjoint dead upper-triangle quadrants, reducing dynamic shared from 80 KiB to 64 KiB; validation and guards pass; n128 112.206 us, full metric 1035.622510

Skip TMEM epilogue chunks wholly above the lower triangle, reducing paired loads from 224 to 100 per CTA; validation and guards pass; n128 106.535 us, full metric 1044.961838 (other-shape benchmark noise regressed aggregate)

Halve native CTA to 256 threads with two-pass panel solves and strided TMEM column groups to target three-CTA residency; validation and guards pass; n128 109.270 us, full metric 1039.847195 (extra serial work outweighed occupancy)
Use compact M64 tcgen05 instructions and half-subpartition x8 TMEM loads for the four updates with trailing <=64; validation and guards pass; n128 95.381 us, full metric 1033.681767
Have only tid0 poll tcgen05 completion, then bridge visibility with before/after thread-sync fences around a CTA barrier; validation and guards pass; n128 96.135 us, full metric 1031.136371

Combine compensated tcgen05 products into one 128-column TMEM accumulator using negative HH, scale-input-d=6, and Q=(H+64R)/8; validation and fresh guards pass with improved n128 residual 0.239; n128 102.145 us, full 1042.569933, so six MMA issues regress latency.

Remap each tcgen05 packing warp-task to four rows by eight K values, reducing high/scaled shared-store bank conflicts without changing descriptors; full validation and guards pass; n128 improves 95.381 to 94.569 us, full 1033.897224.

Use a four-pass Latin K-group permutation over eight rows per warp: exact original address set, two-way source loads, conflict-free high/scaled stores; validation and fresh guards pass; n128 improves 94.569 to 93.813 us (1.65% from native baseline), full 1033.865294.

Split packing into disjoint K8 stages, issue first high/scaled tcgen05 MMAs before packing K8-15, order the second issue with canonical tcgen fences, and commit once; validation/guards pass; n128 regresses 93.813 to 94.962 us from extra CTA barrier, aggregate 1030.029618 benefits from unrelated shape noise.

Replace staged K8 CTA barrier with a 16-arrival shared mbarrier: one release arrival per synchronized warp and leader acquire before second MMA issue; validation/guards pass, but mbarrier traffic regresses n128 further to 95.514 us; full 1030.177260 is dominated by unrelated shape noise.
Remove scaled compensated product, its packing/MMA/TMEM load, and halve TMEM allocation. Dense n128 residual rises 0.381 to 11.6 and spectrum n128 produces NaN/Inf, so uncompensated TF32 is invalid.

Keep compensated tcgen05 updates through panel80 but use high-only TF32 for final 16x16 panel96; official validation and guards pass (dense n128 residual 1.32), but n128 regresses 93.813 to 94.172 us, likely from retained conditional overhead; full 1028.701612 reflects unrelated-shape shifts.

Extend high-only updates to final panels80 and96; official validation and guards still pass (dense n128 residual 2.41), but n128 is 94.325 us versus 93.813 fully compensated, confirming conditional/accuracy-bound reduction is not profitable; full 1031.032279.

Fuse tcgen05 high/scaled packing into solve_panel: each four-thread team writes its solved row directly from registers into the exact M128/M64 layout, eliminating panel rereads and seven CTA barriers; validation/guards and residuals unchanged; n128 improves 93.813 to 93.208 us, full 1029.955283.

Rewrite each four-thread panel solve as exact right-looking forward substitution, reducing four shuffles per pivot to one; validation/guards pass and residuals slightly improve, but serialized pivot FMAs regress n128 93.208 to 96.382 us; full 1033.783401.

Pair high/scaled TMEM accumulators in one tcgen05 load using lane-xor16 exchange: M128 16x32bx2.x32 and M64 32x32b.x16; validation/guards pass, but shuffle/half-writer overhead regresses n128 93.208 to 97.713 us; full 1033.891550.

Persist each factor-panel reciprocal in dead upper scratch and multiply by it in all solve teams; validation/guards pass (dense residual 0.386), clean run n128 93.309 us versus 93.208 baseline with high variance; a repeat was globally contended and discarded; full clean metric 1029.104799.

Overlap independent tile loads with tcgen05 allocation and mbarrier initialization, publishing all setup state with one CTA barrier instead of two; validation/guards unchanged; n128 improves 93.208 to 93.013 us, full 1029.843346.
Remove factor_panel_16_warp terminal __syncwarp because every caller immediately reaches a CTA barrier; validation/guards unchanged; n128 improves 93.013 to 92.904 us, full 1025.530501.

Specialize factor_panel warp entry sync: omit it for initial/M128 self-row writers and retain it for M64 split-row writers; validation/guards pass, n128 92.923 us versus 92.904 baseline (neutral/slight regression), full 1029.311524.

Overwrite dead M128 high-product registers with updated diagonal-panel rows and factor them in place, eliminating 136 shared reloads and entry sync per M128 panel; validation/guards pass (minor subtraction-reassociation residual 0.370); n128 improves 92.904 to 92.336 us, full 1028.372446.
Restore original tile-(high+correction) grouping in register-resident M128 factor path; validation/guards and residuals exactly match baseline; n128 improves again to 92.099 us, full 1030.894255.

Reuse M64 epilogue high/scaled register arrays as split 16-value diagonal rows, exchanging eight upper values with lane-xor16 and factoring in place; eliminates shared reloads and entry sync for four M64 panels; validation/guards and residuals unchanged; n128 improves 92.099 to 91.085 us, full 1026.710187.
Remove now-initial-only factor helper entry __syncwarp after setup CTA barrier; validation/guards unchanged, but n128 91.234 us versus 91.085 baseline (neutral/slight regression); full 1028.313159.

Stage initial 16x16 panel into swizzled dead upper scratch to replace 16-way row-load conflicts with conflict-free copy/factor loads; validation, guards, and exact residuals unchanged, but extra staging regresses n128 91.085 to 91.781 us; full 1027.201956.

Pipeline each next panel solve/pack into the current rank-k epilogue: four first-column warps synchronize after factoring, solve all remaining rows while twelve warps finish disjoint epilogue chunks, and publish through the existing CTA barrier; validation and fresh guards pass, but four-warp solve serialization regresses n128 91.085 to 101.805 us; full 1038.875871.

Exhausted the blocked n128 tensor-core brief after 48 logged trials. Overall winner is f12ace45a06d35f9df172c8c089cae13b72df45c: fused WMMA panel factor at the rank-k tail, n128 58.811 us and full 995.218. Native SM100/tcgen05 exploration covered raw mapping, compact M64 updates, trailing-work pruning, conflict-free and direct-register packing, barrier variants, compensation formulas, register-resident M128/M64 factorization, swizzled initial staging, and early solve/epilogue overlap. Best native frontier is 3751f83282a377c432bc6175cf84d226536a158c at n128 91.085 us/full 1026.710; the final overlap trial remained correct but regressed to 101.805 us. Branch is clean and reset to the overall winner.
